tools.name: iar_documentation_search
tools.description: Search the IAR user documentation (docs.iar.com): IAR Embedded Workbench for Arm, RISC-V, RH850, RL78 and RX (IDE, C/C++ compiler, assembler, linker, C-SPY debugger, C-STAT), IAR debug probes and cloud licensing. Set product to ewarm, ewriscv, ewrh850, ewrl78, ewrx, probes or lmsc. Returns page filenames and excerpts.

filter.description: Optional: document type filter. Leave unset (default 'all') for IAR documentation.

intent.description: Optional: Prioritizes (not filters) results by type. One of 'api', 'tutorial', 'guide', 'concept', 'example', 'migration'. 'api'=class reference, 'tutorial'=how-to guides, 'guide'=overviews, 'concept'=explanations, 'example'=code samples, 'migration'=porting guides.

keywords.description: Optional: array of keywords to search for. Results match ANY keyword. Example: ["pragma", "location", "absolute"]. Alternative to 'query' for multi-term matching.

max_results.description: Optional: Maximum number of results to return (1-10). Default is 3.

module.description: Optional: limit the search to one manual (e.g., 'iarccdevelopment', 'cspydebugging', 'cstatstaticanalysis', 'iarassembler', 'ideprojectmanagementandbuilding', 'migrationinformation').

product.description: Optional: one of 'ewarm' (Arm), 'ewriscv' (RISC-V), 'ewrh850' (RH850), 'ewrl78' (RL78), 'ewrx' (RX), 'probes' (debug probes), 'lmsc' (cloud licensing). Compiler options and pragmas differ per architecture, so always set it.

query.description: Search query (e.g., 'ILINK config file', '#pragma location', 'C-SPY breakpoints'). Optional if 'keywords' is provided.

version.description: Optional: product version to search (e.g., '10.10' for ewarm). Defaults to the latest available version.

tools.name: iar_documentation_read
tools.description: Read the full content of an IAR documentation page. Use the filename shown in search results.

file.description: Documentation page filename from a search result.

symbol.description: Optional: Return only one member's documentation instead of the whole page. A name (e.g. 'singleShot', 'anchors.fill', 'AlignmentFlag', 'onCompleted') returns every overload and any property of that name; an enum constant or property access function returns its enum or property. An anchor, shown as {#anchor} after each signature (e.g. 'singleShot-5'), returns that block only. An unknown name returns the page's member list.

version.description: Optional: product version to read from. Defaults to the latest available version.
